youtube.description:
Free setup, prompt + review checklist: https://withhammad.com/resources/claude-job-search
Claude AI job search with Playwright MCP, in five steps.

Connect the browser tool, add your resume and criteria, research permitted employer career pages, shortlist roles with resume evidence, then draft answers for review. Keep source links and flag missing dates.

Playwright MCP is open source; Claude access and usage are separate. Site permission and compatibility vary. Review your details before entering them on a live form and stop before Submit. This workflow does not submit applications or guarantee employment.

Official tool: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp
